rule: Every root Cargo workspace member is either in the catalog default_source_closure or appears exactly once below as an excluded non-product component.

non_product_members.reason: The G1 default graph uses the bounded owner-open host; the pre-G1 monolith remains buildable only for explicit compatibility and source archaeology.
The G1 owner-open protocol crate is the active default contract surface.
The selected host and versioned owner-open protocol own the active transport boundary.
The active graph separates bounded call and job ownership instead of retaining one legacy registry.
The provider is the sole semantic principal; a second semantic policy plane is forbidden in the owner-open default graph.
The active event store owns bounded correlation and recovery records.
A privilege/Authority hop is not part of the owner-open default graph.
The G1 graph separates byte-preserving tool bridging from lifecycle mechanics.
The retained typed and guarded pre-r3 adapters must not substitute for raw owner-open shell or ordinary ADB.
The active graph preserves exact shell bytes and process observations without a typed semantic broker.
Desktop and alternate distro integration are outside the Android-managed headless Root Linux product.
The former Authority binary is retained only for an explicitly selected sealed compatibility target.
The fixed-control-FD proxy is excluded from the selected owner-open product entrypoint.
